evidence.quote:
Your Auto Scaling group must use a mixed instances policy
+ All overrides in the mixed instances policy must specify an `ImageId` 
+ AMIs must contain only a single root volume
Root volume replacement doesn’t support Elastic Load Balancing.

claim: The replace root volume strategy requires a mixed instances policy whose overrides each specify an ImageId and AMIs that contain only a single root volume, and root volume replacement does not support Elastic Load Balancing.

qualifiers.scope: per instance refresh with the replace root volume strategy
